title_en: Yangtze River Delta Commodity Exchange Co., Ltd. v. Lu Haiyun — dispute over return of original property
ruling_gist_en: A lien is a security device for the satisfaction of claims between parties of equal status; except for liens between enterprises, the chattel retained by the creditor shall belong to the same legal relationship as the claim.

full_text_en:
Yangtze River Delta Commodity Exchange Co., Ltd. v. Lu Haiyun — dispute over return of property

[Ruling Summary]

The right of lien is a security method for realizing claims between equal subjects; except for liens between enterprises, the chattel retained by the creditor shall belong to the same legal relationship as the claim.

The parties in a labor relationship are in an unequal relationship of management and being managed during the performance of the labor contract. Where a worker claims to exercise a lien over chattels such as tools and articles supplied by the employer for his use on the ground that the employer has defaulted on labor remuneration, such chattels are not the subject matter of the labor contract relationship and do not belong to the same legal relationship as the labor claim, therefore the people's court shall not support such a claim.

Plaintiff: Yangtze River Delta Commodity Exchange Co., Ltd., domiciled at Gaolang East Road, Binhu District, Wuxi City, Jiangsu Province.
Legal Representative: Zhai Xiaoping, Chairman of the Company.
Defendant: Lu Haiyun, male, Han ethnicity, 50 years old, residing in Chong'an District, Wuxi City, Jiangsu Province.

The plaintiff, Yangtze River Delta Commodity Exchange Co., Ltd. (hereinafter referred to as Yangtze River Delta Company), filed an action with the Chong'an District People's Court of Wuxi City, Jiangsu Province, against the defendant, Lu Haiyun, for a dispute over return of property.

The plaintiff, Yangtze River Delta Company, alleged: The defendant, Lu Haiyun, was originally the deputy general manager of Yangtze River Delta Company. To facilitate Lu Haiyun's work, Yangtze River Delta Company allocated a Jetta sedan with license plate Su B××××× to Lu Haiyun for his use. Later, the management level of Yangtze River Delta Company was adjusted. Lu Haiyun refused to accept the adjustment arrangement and was absent from work for many days. Therefore, Yangtze River Delta Company issued a disciplinary notice on February 21, 2014, stating that Lu Haiyun had been absent from work for 13 consecutive days and that his employment was terminated effective immediately, and served the notice on Lu Haiyun on the same day. Therefore, the labor relationship between Yangtze River Delta Company and Lu Haiyun had been terminated. Therefore, Lu Haiyun has no right to continue to occupy the vehicle, nor has he the right to exercise a lien over the vehicle with license plate Su B××××× on the ground of a labor dispute, for the following reasons: 1. The labor dispute between Lu Haiyun and Yangtze River Delta Company should be governed by labor law, and the property law right of lien cannot be used to oppose Yangtze River Delta Company. 2. The allocation of the vehicle to Lu Haiyun by Yangtze River Delta Company was not based on the labor relationship, but was a benefit provided to a senior executive, which does not belong to the same legal relationship as the dispute over wages and social insurance premiums; Yangtze River Delta Company has the right under property law ownership to demand the return of the vehicle from Lu Haiyun. 3. Even if Lu Haiyun has applied for labor arbitration, the arbitration award has not yet taken effect, and the creditor's right and debt have not been determined; therefore, Lu Haiyun has no right to retain the property of Yangtze River Delta Company. 4. Because Lu Haiyun refused to return the vehicle with license plate Su B×××××, Yangtze River Delta Company was forced to pay additional expenses for employees to take taxis and rent cars when on business trips. After consulting with various car rental companies, the rental price for a Jetta sedan is approximately RMB 100 per day. Therefore, the plaintiff requested the court to order Lu Haiyun to return the vehicle with license plate Su B××××× to Yangtze River Delta Company, and to pay the usage fee for the vehicle with license plate Su B××××× (calculated at RMB 100 per day from February 21, 2014, until the date of return of the vehicle).

The defendant, Lu Haiyun, argued: It is true that the plaintiff, Yangtze River Delta Company, allocated the Jetta sedan with license plate Su B××××× to Lu Haiyun for his use, and that Lu Haiyun received the disciplinary notice served by Yangtze River Delta Company on February 21, 2014. Lu Haiyun agrees to terminate the labor relationship with Yangtze River Delta Company, but does not agree to return the vehicle with license plate Su B×××××: 1. Because Yangtze River Delta Company owes the defendant wages, social insurance premiums, and economic compensation, Lu Haiyun has a creditor's right against Yangtze River Delta Company. Meanwhile, Lu Haiyun has applied to the Binhu District Labor and Personnel Dispute Arbitration Committee of Wuxi City for labor arbitration regarding the labor dispute. 2. The vehicle with license plate Su B××××× was allocated for Lu Haiyun's use by Yangtze River Delta Company during his tenure as deputy general manager; therefore, Lu Haiyun is in lawful possession of the vehicle with license plate Su B××××× based on the labor relationship. 3. The vehicle possessed by Lu Haiyun and the creditor's right both belong to the labor relationship; therefore, Lu Haiyun may exercise a lien over the vehicle with license plate Su B××××× until Yangtze River Delta Company pays the relevant fees in full. 4. The plaintiff's claim for vehicle usage fee has no basis in fact or law; therefore, Lu Haiyun does not agree to pay the vehicle usage fee.

The Chong'an District People's Court of Wuxi City found at first instance:

The Jetta sedan with license plate Su B××××× was registered under the name of the plaintiff, Yangtze River Delta Company. The defendant, Lu Haiyun, was originally the deputy general manager of Yangtze River Delta Company. Yangtze River Delta Company purchased the vehicle on September 6, 2013, and delivered it to Lu Haiyun for his use immediately. On February 21, 2014, Yangtze River Delta Company served on Lu Haiyun the "Disciplinary Notice Regarding Comrade Lu Haiyun's Absence from Work and Misappropriation/Occupation of Company Property," which stated, among other things, that Lu Haiyun had "been absent from work for 13 consecutive days, refused to report to the group logistics park after multiple notices from our company and did not come to the exchange, and misappropriated and refused to return the company car (Jetta Su B×××××). His conduct violated the provisions on absenteeism in Article 15, Chapter 3 of our company's 'Employee Handbook' and the provisions on misappropriation of company property in Article 10, Section 72, Chapter 13, constituting a serious disciplinary violation, and his employment is terminated effective immediately." Lu Haiyun had no objection to the termination of the labor relationship, but believed that the termination by Yangtze River Delta Company was illegal and that the company should pay him the owed wages, social insurance premiums, and economic compensation; therefore, he refused to return the vehicle with license plate Su B××××× to Yangtze River Delta Company.

It was also found: The defendant, Lu Haiyun, applied for labor arbitration to the Binhu District Labor and Personnel Dispute Arbitration Committee of Wuxi City on June 9, 2014. On July 25, 2014, the Committee issued an arbitration award (Case No. Xibin Laoren Zhongcai Zi [2014] No. 339), which stated that the plaintiff, Yangtze River Delta Company, should pay Lu Haiyun a wage difference of RMB 126,000 for the period from January 2013 to January 2014 and economic compensation of RMB 80,000 for illegal termination of the labor contract.

The Chong'an District People's Court of Wuxi City held at first instance:

Because the plaintiff, Yangtze River Delta Company, allocated the vehicle with license plate Su B××××× to the defendant, Lu Haiyun, for his use while he served as deputy general manager of Yangtze River Delta Company, Lu Haiyun lawfully possessed and used the vehicle as arranged by Yangtze River Delta Company. Lu Haiyun lawfully possessed the vehicle based on his labor relationship with Yangtze River Delta Company, and claimed that Yangtze River Delta Company owed him wages and economic compensation based on that labor relationship; therefore, Lu Haiyun has the right to exercise a lien over the vehicle in accordance with the law. Accordingly, after the labor relationship between Lu Haiyun and Yangtze River Delta Company was terminated, Lu Haiyun, based on the fact that Yangtze River Delta Company still owed him wages and economic compensation, has the right to exercise a lien over the vehicle with license plate Su B×××××; therefore, the court does not support Yangtze River Delta Company's claim for the return of the vehicle and payment of the vehicle usage fee.

In conclusion, the Chong'an District People's Court of Wuxi City, pursuant to Article 5 of the General Principles of the Civil Law of the People's Republic of China, rendered the following judgment on August 6, 2014:

[The claim of] Yangtze River Delta Company is dismissed.

Yangtze River Delta Company, dissatisfied with the first-instance judgment, appealed to the Intermediate People's Court of Wuxi City.

The appellant, Yangtze River Delta Company, appealed on the following grounds: 1. The right of lien cannot apply to claims arising from labor relationships. The right of lien is a security right in property with self-help characteristics. According to Article 84 of the Security Law, the right of lien applies only to claims arising from contracts of deposit, transportation, and processing. This case is a labor dispute and has already been submitted for arbitration, seeking public relief; therefore, the right of lien can no longer be applied. 2. Lu Haiyun's possession of the vehicle with license plate Su B××××× is illegal. Lu Haiyun only obtained the right to use the vehicle during his employment, not the complete right to use the vehicle. The right to use the vehicle was subject to time and condition limitations. As a senior executive of the company, Lu Haiyun only obtained the right to use it without requiring approval, but this temporary, short-term right of use does not constitute lawful possession, and therefore there is no room for the application of the right of lien. The appellant requested the court of second instance to amend the judgment according to law. During the proceedings, Yangtze River Delta Company abandoned its claim for payment of the vehicle usage fee for the vehicle with license plate Su B××××× by Lu Haiyun, and only requested the return of the vehicle with license plate Su B××××× from Lu Haiyun.

The respondent, Lu Haiyun, argued: 1. The Property Law expanded the scope of application of the right of lien from the original Security Law, which is not limited to claims arising from contracts of deposit, transportation, and processing. The claim arising from the labor relationship of Lu Haiyun may be subject to the right of lien. 2. Lu Haiyun was in lawful possession of the vehicle with license plate Su B××××× as deputy general manager of Yangtze River Delta Company, satisfying the requirement of "lawful possession" for the establishment of the right of lien. Although Yangtze River Delta Company, dissatisfied with the labor arbitration, has also filed a lawsuit, Lu Haiyun's claim has still not been satisfied; therefore, he should have the right to exercise the right of lien. The respondent requested that the appeal be dismissed and the original judgment affirmed.

The Intermediate People's Court of Wuxi City, upon second-instance trial, confirmed the facts found in the first-instance trial.

It was additionally found:

1. The appellant, Yangtze River Delta Company, dissatisfied with the arbitration award (Case No. Xibin Laoren Zhongcai Zi [2014] No. 339), has already filed a lawsuit with the Binhu District People's Court of Wuxi City; that case is still pending.
2. During the second-instance trial, the appellant, Yangtze River Delta Company, provided one "Full-time Labor Contract" to prove that the respondent, Lu Haiyun, as a senior executive of the company, was assigned to a management position. Yangtze River Delta Company further explained the work content of the management position as administrative management, finance, and personnel work. Lu Haiyun did not object to the authenticity or legality of the "Full-time Labor Contract" and also acknowledged that Lu Haiyun was nominally in charge of the overall work of the exchange, but in practice was responsible for administrative management, finance, and personnel work. Accordingly, the court confirmed Lu Haiyun's management position and his main responsibilities of "administrative management, finance, and personnel work."

The issue in dispute in this second-instance trial was: Whether the respondent, Lu Haiyun, could exercise a right of lien over the vehicle with license plate Su B××××× owned by the appellant, Yangtze River Delta Company, for his labor claim.

The Intermediate People's Court of Wuxi City held in second instance:

The right of lien is a security method for realizing claims between equal subjects; except for liens between enterprises, the chattel retained by the creditor shall belong to the same legal relationship as the claim. The parties in a labor relationship are in an unequal relationship of management and being managed during the performance of the labor contract. Where a worker claims to exercise a lien over chattels such as tools and articles supplied by the employer for his use on the ground that the employer has defaulted on labor remuneration, such chattels are not the subject matter of the labor contract relationship and do not belong to the same legal relationship as the labor claim; therefore, this claim is contrary to the law. The appellant's grounds of appeal are well-founded and should be adopted. The reasons are as follows:

1. The right of lien cannot be exercised for a claim arising from a labor relationship. Article 230 of the Property Law provides that "if the debtor fails to perform his obligation when it falls due, the creditor may retain the chattel of the debtor which is already in his lawful possession and has the right to be paid in priority out of the proceeds from the chattel." Article 231 provides that "the chattel retained by the creditor shall belong to the same legal relationship as the creditor's claim, unless the parties are both enterprises." According to legal provisions and the structure of the legal system, one of the requirements for the exercise of the right of lien is the existence of a creditor-debtor relationship between equal subjects. The right of lien is one of the security rights in property, stipulated in the General Principles of the Civil Law, the Security Law, the Property Law, and other civil law systems of our country. Its object of regulation is the civil security relationship between equal subjects, excluding the application of security law to claims arising from management acts. The right of lien is, in nature, a method for realizing claims between equal subjects. Its equality is manifested in the fact that the creditor can oppose the debtor by retaining the debtor's chattel, urging the debtor to perform his obligation, and can protect the claim by converting the retained property and obtaining priority payment. However, in a labor relationship, one party is the employer and the other is the worker. Compared with ordinary civil relations, the parties are in an unequal relationship of management and being managed during the performance of the labor contract. A worker cannot apply a lien over the employer's property in his possession based on a labor management relationship; otherwise, it would lead to disorder in labor management. Our country's Labor Law and Labor Contract Law have already set tilt protection clauses for the lawful rights of workers. Workers can fully protect their labor claims through statutory legitimate channels. If self-help remedies are used to protect labor claims, it would not only affect labor production and management order but also create unfairness in the protection of claims. Furthermore, because the right of lien has priority in payment, not only over ordinary creditors but also over other creditors with rights of mortgage or pledge, and labor disputes arise between the employer and the worker, essentially an internal dispute of an economic organization, from the perspective of the employer and the worker sharing business risks, the worker should not be able to obtain priority in payment over external creditors by exercising the right of lien.

2. The vehicle with license plate Su B××××× retained by the respondent, Lu Haiyun, is not the subject matter of the parties' labor contract relationship and does not satisfy the constituent element of "the same legal relationship." Except for liens between enterprises, the retained chattel shall belong to the same legal relationship as the claim. This actually imposes a strict limitation on the scope of chattels subject to the right of lien. The so-called "same legal relationship" means that the creditor's possession of the chattel is based on the same legal relationship from which his claim arises; there is a close connection between the chattel and the claim. The basic legal relationship of a labor contract is that the worker undertakes the obligation to provide labor to the employer and to accept the employer's management, and has the right to demand that the employer pay labor remuneration as agreed. In this case, Lu Haiyun was placed by the appellant, Yangtze River Delta Company, in a management position responsible for administrative affairs, finance, and personnel work. Therefore, the vehicle with license plate Su B××××× retained by Lu Haiyun was merely a convenience provided by Yangtze River Delta Company for the travel of its senior executives, and was not the subject matter of the labor relationship established between the parties. Yangtze River Delta Company could recall the vehicle at any time without affecting the performance of the original labor relationship. Yangtze River Delta Company demanded the return of the vehicle from Lu Haiyun based on ownership, not on the labor relationship. Therefore, Lu Haiyun's possession of the vehicle with license plate Su B××××× and his claimed labor claims such as wages and social insurance premiums are not based on the same legal relationship.

3. The parties' labor relationship had already been terminated, and the respondent, Lu Haiyun, lost the basis for his lawful possession of the vehicle with license plate Su B×××××. As a convenience enjoyed by a senior executive of the appellant, Yangtze River Delta Company, Lu Haiyun's lawful possession of the vehicle with license plate Su B××××× was subject to time and condition limitations. After the parties' labor relationship was terminated, the conditions for Lu Haiyun's lawful possession of the vehicle with license plate Su B××××× ceased to exist; he should return the vehicle with license plate Su B××××× to Yangtze River Delta Company.

In conclusion, the first-instance judgment found the facts clearly but applied the law incorrectly, and should be corrected. The appellant, Yangtze River Delta Company, abandoning its claim for payment of the vehicle usage fee for the vehicle with license plate Su B××××× by the respondent, Lu Haiyun, is a disposition of its own lawful rights. Accordingly, the Intermediate People's Court of Wuxi City, pursuant to Articles 230 and 231 of the Property Law of the People's Republic of China and Article 170, Paragraph 1, Item (2) of the Civil Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China, rendered the following judgment on November 17, 2014:

1. The civil judgment (Case No. 2014) Chong Min Chu Zi No. 0562 rendered by the Chong'an District People's Court of Wuxi City on August 6, 2014, is reversed.
2. Lu Haiyun shall return the vehicle with license plate Su B××××× to Yangtze River Delta Company within ten days from the date this judgment takes effect.

Court costs of first instance in the amount of RMB 875 and court costs of second instance in the amount of RMB 875 shall be borne by Lu Haiyun.

This judgment is final.
